title: ze_peach_castle_n64
description:
Welcome back in the mushroom kingdom !

Princess Peach invited you for a cake, but she seems to be nowhere in her castle... Search every room, look every painting, and collect the super stars to open new path that may lead to our princess... Unless she is in another castle ?

New players watch out ! If there are skulls in some places, maybe it's a warning for a close danger...

_ 4 main levels
_ 1 secret level
_ admin room
_ custom level voting system (thanks to the big manly man ShadoW for his HUGE help) play what you want when you want
_ the map is designed like a video game's main quest : keep progressing and unlock its secrets
_ Each level has its own originality
_ selfmade sprites and particles
_ HD textures ripped off directly from nintendo
_ selfmade models (except for the ones available on the models-ressource.com). Thanks to Kaesar for his Bowser's animations
_ Thanks to Easter for his overlays (screen text, health bar and underwater <3)

This map is my submission to the S2ZE mapping contest 2025 Return to roots ! Please have fun and give me feedback for every problem you may encounter.
